mustFix.problem: A readable ONE WAY sign, a second street sign and a parking sign sit in the hero frame, and the sign is the focal point; a flat vector lamppost is pasted over the photo.
mustFix.fix: Re-crop with object-position so the porch and columns fill the frame and the sign pole falls outside it (e.g. object-position: 20% 60%, or a tighter crop on the porch). If no crop clears it, use a different approved house frame. Remove the vector lamppost or place it where no real sign sits behind it.

mustFix.problem: A gable photo renders as an empty gradient depending on the story's JS state, including with reduced motion; the caption describes an image that is not shown.
mustFix.fix: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, and as the default before JS runs, set every [data-slot^="story-"] img to opacity 1 with no transform. With motion on, start the active frame visible and only fade non-active frames between cards; never leave a frame without its image while its card is in view.

elevate.move: Make the photography do the dusk: grade each frame to its clock minute (7:40 warm, 9:20 deep indigo) so the light visibly falls across the four gables as the clock advances and the grade carries the thesis rather than a single filter, starting from a hero frame that is the house and its porch light with no street furniture.

Make the static story a designed state: with reduced motion or no JS, render the four houses as a still 'evening contact sheet' with every gable photo, drawing, time stamp and check points visible, so nothing in the story depends on scroll position and the reduced-motion page reads as complete as the animated one.
